verses.tl: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa fatalliqoohunna li-iddatihinna wa ahsul-iddata wattaqoo Allaaha rabbakum laa tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wa laa yakhrujna illaa an ya'teena bifaahishatin mubayyinatin wa tilka hudoodu Allaahi wa man yata'adda hudooda Allaahi faqad zalama nafsahu laa tadree la-alla Allaaha yuhdithu ba'da dhaalika amraa

Fa-idhaa balaghna ajalahunna fa-amsikoohunna bima'roofin aw faariqoohunna bima'roofin wa ashhidoo dhaway adlin minkum wa aqeemush-shahaadata Lillaahi dhaalikum yoo'azu bihi man kaana yu'minu Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa man yattaqi Allaaha yaj'al lahu makhrajaa
Wa yarzuqhu min haythu laa yahtasibu wa man yatawakkal alaa Allaahi fahuwa hasbuhu innallaaha baalighu amrihi qad ja'ala Allaahu likulli shay'in qadraa

Wal-laa'ee ya'isna minal-maheedi min nisaa'ikum inir-tabtum fa-iddatuhunna thalaathatu ashhurin wal-laa'ee lam yahidna wa ulaatul-ahmaali ajaluhunna an yada'na hamlahunna wa man yattaqi Allaaha yaj'al lahu min amrihi yusraa
Dhaalika amru Allaahi anzalahu ilaykum wa man yattaqi Allaaha yukaffir anhu sayyi'aatihi wa yu'zim lahu ajraa

Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wa laa tudaarroohunna litudayyiqoo alayhinna wa in kunna oolaati hamlin fa-anfiqoo alayhinna hattaa yada'na hamlahunna fa-in arda'na lakum fa-aatoohunna ujoorahunna wa tamiroo baynakum bima'roofin wa in ta'aasartum fasaturdi'u lahu ukhraa
Liyunfiq dhoo sa'atin min sa'atihi wa man qudira alayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimmaa aataahu Allaahu laa yukallifu Allaahu nafsan illaa maa aataahaa sayaj'alu Allaahu ba'da usrin yusraa
Wa ka'ayyin min qaryatin atat an amri rabbihaa wa rusulihi fahaasabnaahaa hisaaban shadeedan wa adhdhabnaahaa adhaaban nukraa
Fadhaaqat wabaala amrihaa wa kaana aaqibatu amrihaa khusraa
A'adda Allaahu lahum adhaaban shadeedan fattaqoo Allaaha yaa ulil-albaabil-ladheena aamanoo qad anzala Allaahu ilaykum dhikraa

Rasoolan yatloo alaykum aayaati Allaahi mubayyinaatin liyukhrijal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori wa man yu'min Billaahi wa ya'mal saalihan yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan qad ahsana Allaahu lahu rizqaa
Allaahul-ladhee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin wa minal-ardi mithlahunna yatanazzalul-amru baynahunna lita'lamoo annallaaha alaa kulli shay'in qadeerun wa annallaaha qad ahaata bikulli shay'in ilmaa
